configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Settings shared by every preset. Not selectable directly. Carries FREE_BREAKFAST_GPU_BACKEND=CUDA, which the hip presets override -- the root CMakeLists refuses to configure without it.

configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Release build inside the project image, using its prebuilt /opt dependencies. The one preset the normal workflow uses.

configurePresets.name: workstation
configurePresets.description: The same configuration into build-workstation/, so a host build and a container build can coexist without reconfiguring each other. Dependencies come from the system package manager rather than /opt.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Debug + AddressSanitizer on host code, into build-asan/

configurePresets.name: compute-sanitizer
configurePresets.description: Debug build for the NVIDIA compute-sanitizer memcheck/racecheck run. CUDA only -- ROCm's equivalent is a different tool.

configurePresets.name: coverage
configurePresets.description: Debug + clang source-based coverage for host code, into build-coverage/. Driven by devtools/coverage.sh.

configurePresets.name: hip
configurePresets.description: The ROCm/HIP backend, into build-hip/. Needs ROCm and an AMD card, not CUDA -- use the hip or combined devcontainer.

configurePresets.name: hip-asan
configurePresets.description: The HIP backend, Debug + AddressSanitizer on host code, into build-hip-asan/

configurePresets.name: hip-experimental
configurePresets.description: hip plus FREE_BREAKFAST_BUILD_EXPERIMENTAL=ON, into build-hip-experimental/. The experimental preset is CUDA, so without this one nothing under experimental/ is ever compiled for ROCm -- which matters for anything there whose whole question is whether the AMD library supports it.

configurePresets.name: ci-cuda
configurePresets.description: What .github/workflows/ci.yml builds for CUDA: the whole tree with the architecture PINNED, so configure never queries a driver, and a test preset that excludes the gpu label. Runnable here to reproduce a CI failure exactly.

configurePresets.name: ci-hip
configurePresets.description: The HIP half, deliberately the SAME SHAPE as ci-cuda: the whole tree through clang's -x hip front end, then the same -LE gpu. Compiling the sources is the point -- clang is the stricter of the two front ends. Needs no device.

testPresets.name: asan
testPresets.description: Debug + AddressSanitizer. ASAN_OPTIONS=protect_shadow_gap=0 is REQUIRED, not tuning: ASan's reserved shadow gap collides with the GPU driver's own large virtual-address reservation, and without it the first device allocation fails as cudaErrorMemoryAllocation / hipErrorOutOfMemory on a card with plenty of free memory.

testPresets.name: hip-asan
testPresets.description: Debug + AddressSanitizer. ASAN_OPTIONS=protect_shadow_gap=0 is REQUIRED, not tuning: ASan's reserved shadow gap collides with the GPU driver's own large virtual-address reservation, and without it the first device allocation fails as cudaErrorMemoryAllocation / hipErrorOutOfMemory on a card with plenty of free memory.
